notes:
posthog.ts: The identifyUser delta adds window.logger calls on both the skipped path and the identify path; control flow is UNCHANGED -- the `if (!ph) { window.logger(...); return; }` block still returns before ph.identify (verified lines 26-29), and the success path logs then identifies. trackEvent DOES guard against missing posthog identically to identifyUser: `const ph = getPosthog(); if (!ph) { window.logger(...); return; }` (lines 42-46), so ph.capture (line 49) only runs when ph is truthy. trackEvent therefore NEVER throws when posthog isn't loaded -- every form call site's onSuccess is safe. window.logger is always defined (app/javascript/shared/logger.ts:1-5 assigns it to either console.log or a no-op depending on IS_DEVELOPMENT/CONSOLE_LOG_ENABLED), so the added logging cannot throw. The logged `user`/`properties` objects contain email (PII), but window.logger is a browser-console no-op outside dev/debug and this matches the pre-existing logging pattern (trackEvent already logged; OnboardingProfile.tsx:20 already logs currentOrganizationUser at render) -- not a new defect. getPosthog relies on posthog.__loaded, the existing pre-feature guard pattern; unchanged.

OnboardingProfile.tsx: isNewOwner is derived at render from useCurrentSession() (currentUser, currentOrganizationUser). It is NEVER undefined -- `!wasInvited` is boolean and `currentUser?.createdVia !== "created_via_invite"` is boolean, so the `&&` yields boolean even if currentUser were undefined (would be true&&true=true). The router guarantees currentUser is loaded and defined BEFORE OnboardingProfile mounts: AppAuthRouter.tsx:427 gates the whole Switch on `!isLoadingUser && !isLoadingOrganization`, and needsOnboardingProfileRoute (line 303) returns null unless `currentUser != undefined && currentUser?.email`, only rendering the Route when hasCompletedProfile is false (lines 324-332). So isNewOwner is computed on fully-loaded data at mount. Branch correctness verified end-to-end: new owners get role org_owner (api/v1/organizations_controller.rb:43 `organization_user.org_owner!`), which is NOT in wasInvited's {org_user, org_admin, org_interviewer} set -> wasInvited=false -> organization_owner_email_verified. Invited users get an invited role via user.rb:97 `current_organization_user.update(role: invite.role)` -> wasInvited=true -> invited_user_email_verified. createdVia is a real serialized field (concerns/created_via_able.rb:7-9 enum incl. created_via_invite:1; api/v1/session_serializer.rb:29 exposes it) acting as a secondary backstop that only matters when wasInvited=false. All field/role names verified real (no typos). Per D18/D19 both events fire unconditionally on mount with [] deps, exactly one branch, for all populations including SSO -- confirmed the useEffect (lines 28-35) has no session-state guard. props.isLoadingOrganization (JSX line 44) is never passed by the Route render (only react-router renderProps flow through), so that loading branch is dead, but it is pre-existing and does not affect the useEffect firing. Re-fire on remount is a SETTLED LOW; not re-flagged. Both files are correct -- no HIGH/BLOCKER/MED feature defects found. Chains traced: OnboardingProfile.tsx -> posthog.ts(trackEvent) -> logger.ts; OnboardingProfile.tsx -> CurrentSessionContext.tsx -> AppAuthRouter.tsx; isNewOwner -> organization_user.rb + organizations_controller.rb:43 + user.rb:97 + created_via_able.rb + session_serializer.rb:29.
